left.title: Biden reverses Trump's transgender military ban
left.body: President Joe Biden on Monday signed an executive order repealing the ban on transgender people serving openly in the military, a ban that former President Donald Trump had put in effect, the White House said. In a statement, the White House said Biden's order "sets the policy that all Americans who are qualified to serve in the Armed Forces of the United States should be able to serve."
left.roundup: President Joe Biden signed an executive order on Monday reversing former President Donald Trump’s policy of restricting transgender soldiers’ military service. Biden’s order revokes Trump’s 2018 Presidential Moratorium on Military Service by Transgender Individuals, which mandated that transgender soldiers identify with their biological sex, banned recruits with a gender dysphoria diagnosis, and stopped covering gender reassignment surgery on military health plans. Furthermore, Biden’s order states that “it shall be the policy of the United States” that transgender soldiers may serve “openly and free from discrimination.” Coverage in right-rated outlets was less common and more likely to focus on the issue of trans health coverage. Coverage in left- and center-rated outlets was more common and more likely to refer to Trump’s policy as a “transgender ban.”

center.title: Biden ends Trump ban on transgender service members
center.body: Less than two years after then-President Donald Trump’s ban on transgender service members went into effect, President Joe Biden has reversed it. An executive order signed Monday requires both the Pentagon and the Homeland Security Department, which oversees the Coast Guard, to remove gender identity as a bar to service. “The all-volunteer force thrives when it is composed of diverse Americans who can meet the rigorous standards for military service, and an inclusive military strengthens our national security,” according to a release from the White House.

right.title: Biden Ends Partial Ban on Transgender Soldiers in U.S. Military
right.body: President Biden signed an executive order on Monday to lift restrictions on transgender Americans who wish to serve in the U.S. military. Biden’s order allows all transgender soldiers to serve openly and to receive gender reassignment surgery under the military’s health plans.
